resources.string: Genuine Huawei Health UI readings → local KinetiQ receiver. No simulation.

Reads the heart rate, blood oxygen and stress values that Huawei Health shows on its home screen and forwards only those visible readings to the local KinetiQ receiver. Nothing is simulated or typed: if a value is not on screen it is sent as empty.
Connection not tested yet. The test only sends a GET.

Demo: 1) run the receiver on the laptop, 2) connect USB and run "adb reverse tcp:8000 tcp:8000" (or set the laptop LAN URL), 3) enable the accessibility service, 4) Start streaming, 5) open Huawei Health and leave its home screen visible. Values are read from the screen only; missing values are sent as null, never 0.
